metadata.title: World Digest — November 15, 2026
metadata.summary: Nvidia closed below $4 trillion as the chipmaker's scandal deepened, while President Trump heads to Manila seeking trade momentum after his party's midterm losses.

sections.title: Major Events
sections.content:
Trump Heads to Asia Summit After Midterm Setbacks

World leaders gather in Manila, seeking trade deals to offset U.S. policy risks as Trump aims to shift momentum abroad. Politico

Zelensky Warns Starshield Restrictions Threaten Ukraine's Defenses

Ukraine's leader urges SpaceX and the U.S. to restore satellite access, vital for energy and drone defenses ahead of winter. BBC

Judge Blocks Trump Administration's Golf Course Renovation

A federal judge halts closure of East Potomac Park, citing procedural issues; the administration plans an immediate appeal. The Guardian

SpaceX Catches Starship Upper Stage in Historic First

The successful orbital capture marks a milestone for reusable rockets, potentially slashing costs for Starlink and deep-space missions. DW.com

U.S. Loses Measles Elimination Status Amid Rising Cases

With deaths reaching 10 and cases topping 5,400, health authorities confirm the country's 26-year elimination streak is over. NPR

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Global Politics

Hundreds of thousands rallied in Prague against government plans to overhaul public media funding, in the largest protest since the Velvet Revolution BBC Newser. In the Russia-Ukraine war, President Zelenskyy said the U.S. floated ceding Ukrainian territory to Russia in exchange for NATO membership CBS News; Russia struck a Kyiv hospital as Starlink disruptions continued The Independent.

Elsewhere, Estonia will close all border crossings with Russia following an attempted arson attack linked to Moscow Al Jazeera. Hungary opened communist-era secret police files, while a probe discovered millions in cash linked to a former Fidesz minister Financial Times Bloomberg.com.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Markets Tumble as Nvidia Scandal Deepens

Nvidia closed below $4T market cap for the first time since July 2025 Axios, as Treasury chief Bessent questions earnings and calls for an outside CEO Axios. Reports detail alleged chip smuggling to China via backdoor routes The Washington Post WSJ. Jensen Huang resigned amid fallout Reuters; earnings due Nov. 17 may steer AI sell-off Financial Times.

Equities: S&P 500 hits rare 156-year milestone The Motley Fool. Energy: US diesel falls to 2-month low below $6 Reuters. M&A: Diamondback nears $5B Permian deal Financial Times. Consumer: Credit card debt hits $1.29T record Fox Business. Retirement: IRS raises 2027 401(k) limit by $1,000 Fox Business.

sections.title: Tech News
sections.content:
Windows 'SignDrop' Zero-Day Exploit Grants SYSTEM Privileges

A disgruntled researcher publicly dropped the "SignDrop" exploit, which abuses a Windows security feature to grant SYSTEM access and disable third-party antivirus and EDR software Wccftech. The flaw turns Microsoft's own fix against itself, leaving systems exposed. Ars Technica confirms the zero-day hands attackers System rights, with multiple outlets tracking the active threat Wccftech.

Xbox Project Helix Confirmed as Console, Not PC

Microsoft clarified that Project Helix is a console, not a PC, but it will play PC games Pure Xbox. Reports suggest AMD's Magnus hybrid chip includes a separate memory subsystem, with neural rendering potentially aiding affordability Pure Xbox. The announcement follows Xbox's 25th anniversary celebrations XBOX Wire.

GTA VI Preorders Top $1 Billion Ahead of Launch

Take-Two CEO confirmed presales are "far in excess" of expectations, with Forbes reporting over $1 billion in preorders The Guardian. The game launches next week with a 212 GB download NDTV.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content: Johnny Depp’s Ebenezer scored his first No. 1 global opening in eight years with a $42M bow, defying poor reviews Deadline. Bowen Yang returned to SNL as ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang The New York Times. Richard Sterban, bass singer of The Oak Ridge Boys, died at 83 The Hollywood Reporter. VisionQuest ended on a series high for Disney Gizmodo. Phoebe Bridgers stunned with a skeletal SNL performance Pitchfork.

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Football

Buffalo Bills 31, New York Jets 12 — Josh Allen powered Buffalo to its best start in 35 years; the Jets lost Geno Smith twice ESPN. Detroit Lions 35, New England Patriots 10 — St. Brown and Gibbs each scored twice in Munich after Patriots QB Maye left injured ESPN. Kansas City Chiefs 35, Atlanta Falcons 13 — Mahomes threw five touchdowns as the Chiefs rolled ESPN.

College Football

Oklahoma beat Ole Miss for a second straight win ESPN. Clemson lost QB Tait Reynolds for the season (torn meniscus) and backup Christopher Vizzina (concussion) ESPN.

Basketball

Philadelphia 76ers 131, Indiana Pacers 124 — the 76ers moved to 11-3 ESPN. Miami Heat 137, Detroit Pistons 117 — Antetokounmpo scored 34 in a fourth straight win ESPN.

Hockey

Winnipeg Jets 5, Chicago Blackhawks 4 (SO) — Winnipeg erased a 4-goal deficit ESPN. Minnesota Wild 6, Boston Bruins 2 — Hartman scored twice; Wild won an eighth straight road game ESPN.

Baseball

Left-hander Tim Hill agreed to a one-year, $2.25 million deal with the Yankees ESPN.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

Recent listings include Modern Mining Technology (MDRN) at $4.25 and vVARDIS Holding (VVVV) at $18, both on Nov 13 Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Upcoming: Bluerock Acquisition II (BRRK) and Southport Acquisition II (PORT) on Nov 16 Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance, and Anthropic (ANT) on Nov 19 Yahoo Finance.

Major Indices

The S&P 500 slipped 0.40% to 7,561.67, while the Nasdaq fell 0.91% Yahoo Finance. The Dow edged up 0.10% Yahoo Finance. The VIX rose 3.21% to 19.30 Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Consumer Staples led, gaining 1.42% Yahoo Finance. Communication Services (+1.05%) and Energy (+0.98%) also rose Yahoo Finance. Technology lagged sharply, dropping 2.01% Yahoo Finance.

Major Stocks

Meta surged 2.90% Yahoo Finance. Broadcom plunged 4.76% Yahoo Finance. Nvidia fell 2.01% Yahoo Finance. Tesla declined 1.82% Yahoo Finance.

Notable Movers

Liftoff Mobile jumped 30.6% Yahoo Finance; Modine added 27.9% Yahoo Finance. Heartflow dropped 19.1% Yahoo Finance; AMD lost 8.8% Yahoo Finance.

Rates & Commodities

The 10-year yield rose to 5.15% Yahoo Finance. Bitcoin tumbled 6.04% to $64,128 Yahoo Finance. Oil edged down 0.32% Yahoo Finance. Gold gained 0.23% Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
• 24–48 hrs: Nvidia earnings Nov. 17 could steer AI sell-off; watch for interim leadership clarity. GTA VI launch week may move entertainment stocks.
  • Next week: Manila summit outcomes likely test Trump's trade leverage. Starship capture may accelerate Starlink expansion, pressuring rivals.
  • Next month: Ukraine's Starshield restrictions could escalate before winter; SpaceX decision pivotal. Measles response may drive public health policy shifts.
  • Uncertainty: Chip-smuggling probe scope, Windows SignDrop patch timeline, and Fed signals amid rising yields.
